text:
Anna C.: Quick copy review — the "Archive model version" modal reads pretty alarming. can we make it clearer what 'archive' means?
Devon R.: +1. Users think archive = delete sometimes. current sentence: 'Archiving will remove this version from active routes.' feels vague.
Samir: Maybe: 'Archive removes this version from deployment routing and hides it from lists, but you can restore it.' short, action-first.
Anna C.: I like 'remove from deployment routing' but 'hide' feels informal. maybe 'remove from active lists' or 'move to archived versions'.
Luis M.: Also think we need a line about data/metrics: does archiving affect logs/metrics? if yes say so. if no, say 'metrics retained'.
Devon R.: Good call. Product decision: metrics retained. can we add one line: 'This action does not delete logs or usage metrics.'
Samir: For CTA copy, current buttons: [Archive] (destructive style) and [Cancel]. Should we change Archive -> 'Archive version' and tone down color? archiving isn't irreversible. maybe neutral primary not danger.
Anna C.: Accessibility nit: make primary the safe action. So primary should be 'Archive version' (clarifying) and secondary 'Cancel'. But color: use neutral blue not red.
Luis M.: Also suggest adding a short confirmation phrase for keyboard users: place focus on 'Archive version' and add aria-describedby pointing to the 'metrics retained' line.
ui-bot: Reminder: modal copy length should be <= 240 chars per guideline. current draft 312 chars.
Anna C.: Ok trim attempt: 'Archive this model version to remove it from active routing. You can restore archived versions later. This does not delete logs or usage metrics.' (140 chars). Thoughts?
Devon R.: That reads clean. Can we replace 'restore' with 'reactivate' ? reactivate may be clearer in context of deployment.
Samir: 'Reactivate' is better. updated line: 'You can reactivate archived versions later.'
Luis M.: LGTM. small UX ask: include a link to the archived versions page: '[View archived versions]' under the message.
Anna C.: Great — I'll update the modal: copy as above + link. I will also change the Archive button to neutral primary and add aria-describedby. Will push to PR after design review.
Devon R.: thanks! tagging @samir for any engineering constraints on focus behavior.
Samir: I'll check keyboard focus in the PR, should be straightforward.
Anna C.: PR link when ready pls. :thumbsup:
